scope: Theorem 4.1 (Classical synthesis) of the manuscript “QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit” (preprints/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite collection of bounded smooth odd seed-only exclusion formulas of Definition 3.3, with disjoint positive-probability helper masks, one for each positive aggregation depth, absent from all their dependencies and with output angle zero on their union H, and every η > 0, there is a finite seeded circuit whose insertion vector v satisfies ∥1Hc (v − vcl)∥ < η, (4.2) where vcl is the insertion vector of (4.1). In particular its value obeys |E(v) − E(m)| ≤ 2η + 2 √ pH. (4.3) The circuit and all its angles are chosen independently of the degree, system size, and disorder. Helper probabilities can be arbitrarily small but are fixed and positive when the construction is performed.
